data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

SummerHaven's most recent 13F, for the period June 30, 2026, shows positions in BMRC and MRBK.

On October 16, 2026, BMRC disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403475/000140347526000041/bmrc-20261016.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
